questions.prompt: Why must you NEVER put private API keys in `VITE_*` environment variables in a Vue SPA?

options.text: All `VITE_*` variables are statically inlined into public client JavaScript shipped to every browser

questions.prompt: What causes a hydration mismatch in a Vue SSR / Nuxt application?

options.text: Rendering non-deterministic or browser-only values (like `Date.now()` or `localStorage`) before hydration completes

questions.prompt: Why can `shallowRef` dramatically improve performance when storing a 50,000-row immutable table in Vue?

options.text: Vue avoids recursively wrapping 50,000 objects in deep reactive Proxies
It renders rows on a Canvas

code.source:
const rows = shallowRef([]);
rows.value = await fetchLargeRows();

questions.prompt: What is the risk of using `watch(..., { deep: true })` on a large nested Pinia store or form object?

options.text: Deep traversal on every nested mutation can become a CPU bottleneck

questions.prompt: Select all practices that prevent memory leaks in long-lived Vue SPAs. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Aborting pending `fetch` calls with `AbortController` on cleanup
Stopping global event-bus or WebSocket subscriptions when views unmount
Calling `markRaw()` on large third-party chart/map instances

questions.prompt: Why is `v-memo="[item.id, item.selected]"` useful on large `v-for` lists?

options.text: It skips re-rendering and patching a list item's VNode subtree unless the listed dependencies change

questions.prompt: What does `defineProps<Props>()` with TypeScript provide over runtime-only object props?

options.text: Compile-time type checking of prop names/types across templates and `vue-tsc`
Runtime validation of external API JSON

questions.prompt: In Vue 3, why shouldn't you use an `async setup()` without a parent `<Suspense>` boundary?

options.text: Without `<Suspense>`, an async component won't render anything until resolved (or may warn/fail to display fallback)

questions.prompt: What is a common cause of stale UI or double-fetching when using Vue Router + Pinia?

options.text: Triggering fetches in both `onMounted` and an `immediate: true` watcher on `route.params`

questions.prompt: Select all practices that make Vue component tests reliable and maintainable. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Test user-visible output and emitted events/API calls rather than internal `vm` private state
Use `createTestingPinia` or isolated store instances per test
Wait for DOM flushes (`await nextTick()` / `await flushPromises()`) after async actions
Mock every child component and assert internal CSS class names only

questions.prompt: How can you protect sensitive routes (like `/admin`) in a Vue SPA?

options.text: Router `beforeEach` guard alone is sufficient security
Use Router guards for UX redirects AND enforce authorization on every backend API endpoint

questions.prompt: What happens when an optimistic UI update fails on the server (e.g., `PATCH /api/todos/1` returns 500)?

options.text: Roll back the local state to the previous snapshot and surface a clear error message
Nothing; keep the fake success state

code.source:
const prev = [...todos.value];
try { await api.save(); } catch { todos.value = prev; }

questions.prompt: Why is `effectScope()` useful when building complex composables or stores outside components?

options.text: It groups multiple reactive effects (`computed`, `watch`, `watchEffect`) so they can all be disposed together with `scope.stop()`

questions.prompt: Match each Vue performance optimization to the problem it solves.

columns.label: Proxy allocation overhead on huge immutable datasets

questions.prompt: Why should you validate API JSON responses before trusting TypeScript types in a Vue app?

options.text: `fetch` converts JSON to `any` only in dev
TypeScript types are erased at runtime, so unexpected API fields or `null`s won't be caught by `tsc`

questions.prompt: What does `app.config.errorHandler` provide in a Vue 3 application?

options.text: A way to catch CSS errors
A global handler for uncaught component render, lifecycle, and watcher errors for telemetry/fallback

questions.prompt: What is the risk of mutating an array passed into a child via props (`props.items.push(x)`)?

options.text: It mutates the parent's reactive array directly, bypassing explicit events and making data flow hard to trace
It converts the array to a `Set`

questions.prompt: Select all valid accessibility practices in Vue components. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Manage focus when opening/closing modals or route changes

questions.prompt: When migrating from Vue 2 Options API to Vue 3 Composition API, what happened to `$on`, `$off`, and `$once` event bus patterns?

options.text: They were removed in Vue 3; use props/emits, `provide`/`inject`, Pinia, or a tiny external emitter if truly needed

questions.prompt: What does `vue-tsc --noEmit` check in CI that regular `tsc --noEmit` misses?

options.text: TypeScript errors inside `.vue` `<template>` expressions and `<script setup>` blocks

questions.prompt: Match each Vue DevTools or CI check to what it catches.

columns.label: Slow component renders, event triggers, and store mutations

questions.prompt: Why is `watch` with `deep: true` on a reactive object unable to tell `newVal !== oldVal` by reference?

options.text: Because the same mutated object reference is passed for both `newVal` and `oldVal` unless you watch a cloned getter

questions.prompt: What does `customRef` allow you to build in Vue 3?

options.text: A ref with explicit control over dependency tracking (`track()`) and update triggering (`trigger()`), such as a debounced ref

code.source: customRef((track, trigger) => ({ get() { track(); return val; }, set(v) { val = v; trigger(); } }))

questions.prompt: Why should you avoid `v-if="loading"` tearing down a heavy form if a user only triggered a background validation?

options.text: `v-if` unmounts the form and loses local DOM/component state; disable controls or show an inline spinner instead

questions.prompt: Select all valid ways to optimize asset and bundle delivery in a Vite + Vue production build. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Compressing and sizing images appropriately (WebP/AVIF + explicit width/height)
Importing the entire `lodash` CommonJS bundle for one helper
Tree-shaking unused exports by using ES module imports

questions.prompt: What does `triggerRef(myShallowRef)` do?

options.text: Manually forces effects/templates depending on a `shallowRef` to update after mutating its inner `.value`

questions.prompt: In Vue Router, what is the difference between `createWebHistory()` and `createWebHashHistory()`?

options.text: Hash history requires server rewrite rules
`createWebHistory()` uses clean URLs (`/users/1`) and requires server fallback to `index.html`; hash history (`/#/users/1`) works without server config

questions.prompt: What does `defineSlots<{ default(props: { item: Item }): any }>()` provide in Vue 3.3+?

options.text: TypeScript type checking for slot names and scoped slot props

questions.prompt: Why is `await flushPromises()` often needed in component unit tests after mounting a component that fetches data in `onMounted`?

options.text: Pending microtasks from mocked `fetch` Promises must resolve before Vue updates the DOM

questions.prompt: What does `app.use(pinia)` do during Vue app initialization?

options.text: Installs the Pinia plugin so all components can resolve stores

questions.prompt: Select all statements that are true about Vue's `<TransitionGroup>` vs `<Transition>`. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Every child inside `<TransitionGroup>` must have a unique `:key`
`<TransitionGroup>` supports `v-move` CSS classes for list reordering

questions.prompt: What does `getCurrentInstance()` warn against in Vue 3 application code?

options.text: Relying on internal instance properties instead of public APIs (`defineProps`, `provide`/`inject`, `useAttrs`)

questions.prompt: Why should you avoid mutating reactive state inside a `computed()` getter?

options.text: `computed` getters should be pure; side effects or mutations inside them cause infinite loops or unpredictable updates

questions.prompt: What does `onActivated` / `onDeactivated` apply to?

options.text: Components cached inside `<KeepAlive>` when they are toggled in and out

questions.prompt: How can you prevent a `404` on page refresh for `/dashboard/settings` in a Vue SPA deployed to static hosting?

options.text: Configure a rewrite/fallback rule serving `index.html` for unknown non-asset routes

questions.prompt: Select all practices that improve Vue backend integration reliability. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Centralize API client configuration (base URL, auth headers, error normalization)
Handle 401/403 responses consistently (e.g., redirect to login or refresh session)
Use timeouts and retry/backoff only on safe idempotent requests
Ignore HTTP error status codes and assume `res.json()` always succeeds

questions.prompt: What does `watchSyncEffect` do, and why is it rarely needed?

options.text: Runs synchronously on every reactive mutation before batching, which can hurt performance and see half-updated state

questions.prompt: In Vue 3, why is `key` on `<RouterView :key="$route.fullPath" />` sometimes used intentionally?

options.text: To force a full remount of the route component whenever the URL or query string changes

questions.prompt: What does `useId()` (Vue 3.5+) generate?

options.text: A random UUID for database rows
An SSR-stable unique ID per component instance for accessible form labels and ARIA attributes
